description:
Job Details:
  
 Title: Web Developer
 Duration: 4 months 
 Location: Richmond, VA
 Client: Direct Client
  
 Required Skills
 

 VDFP is seeking an experienced (3-5 years minimum) Web Developer to redevelop an existing website (www.vafire.com), as well as redeveloping an existing array of web forms currently in use on the website. 
 The following minimum skill sets are required to include: 
 A solid or even expert grasp of HTML and CSS-based layout practices; Proficiency in the following supporting technologies/ applications--Java Scritp/Java, PHP, ASP.NET, SQL; 
 Familiarity with the technical aspects of web servers and the types of applications and sites that run on them; 
 Knowledge and ability to incorporate responsive design for mobile device support; 
 Ability to incorporate search engine optimization into the overall website; and Experience with Adobe Creative Suite, especially Adobe Dreamweaver. 
 This assignment length is estimated at 520 hours with a possibility to extend for another 520 hours.

 Bachelors

 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
